title: Reverse-engineer claimdesk-web into an evidence-backed inventory and spec
scenario: A modernization pod is about to take over ClaimDesk, a JBoss EAP 7.4 WAR nobody on the pod has read. The last spec, written by asking a chatbot, missed half the database and the batch job, so the architecture board now requires every claim to cite a file and line.
task: Inventory database objects, integrations, authorization checks, scheduled jobs and runtime assumptions in spec/inventory.json
Back every item with app/<path>:<line> evidence whose quote is really on that line
Trace endpoints to their definitions; mark dead code dead
Write a C4-style SPEC.md with risks, blast radius and open questions
acceptance: Schema-valid inventory; every evidence reference resolves
Hidden coverage: tables mapped outside Java SQL, the stored procedure, all live integrations, every auth mechanism, cron and in-server jobs
Precision: nothing invented, dead code not reported as live
SPEC.md is something a pod can plan from (rubric)
